jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
jobs.description:
**Executive Assistant to the CEO**

**Jacob Green & Associates | Tustin, CA | Hybrid**  
**Full-time, hourly, nonexempt | Up to $40.00 per hour (open to part-time if interested)**  
COVER LETTER SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS AT END OF POSTING

**The Opportunity**

The CEO’s flight just changed, a client has requested that Jacob attend a pre-event dinner, and the keynote deck is, predictably, missing the final slide and hasn’t been proofread. If you get fired up because you get to create order out of chaos and your first instinct is to figure out what needs attention now, what can wait, and who needs an update, we’d like to meet you.

Jacob Green & Associates (JGA) helps local government leaders solve tough problems. As our Executive Assistant to the CEO, you’ll report directly to Jacob and manage the details that keep his professional and personal commitments on track, from coordinating travel and preparing for events to booking appointments, making dinner reservations, and ordering gifts. You are the company air traffic controller. You’ll help keep our Tustin office running, support our leadership team, and travel with Jacob to select keynotes, book signings, and other events across California, mostly locally. You’ll have room to take initiative, flag a scheduling decision that doesn’t make sense, and follow through without waiting for a reminder.

**Where and When You’ll Work**

This is a full-time, **hybrid role**. You’ll work remotely for much of the week and come to our Tustin office **two to three days per week, typically for one to two hours per visit**, to meet with Jacob and handle on-site office management responsibilities. Expect on average to support **two to three high-profile events per month**, with some requiring travel within California. Don’t worry, you will never have to miss a family member’s soccer game or that Rams game you have tickets for to accommodate work travel. Family first. Always.

**What You’ll Do**

**Keep the CEO’s day on track**

* Manage Jacob’s calendar, coordinate meetings, and help protect time for his most important commitments. Provide calendar support to two other JGA directors.
* Serve as a point of contact for team members, clients, and partners. Keep people informed when plans change and follow up on open items.
* Prepare and polish PowerPoint decks, reports, and meeting materials. Keep client contacts, leads, and follow-up current in the CRM.
* Handle sensitive business and personal information with discretion.

**Keep the office running**

* Answer the main phone (remotely), welcome visitors, and keep the Tustin office organized and ready for meetings.
* Handle mail, shipping, office supplies, swag inventory management, and occasional post office and bank runs.
* Help with personal scheduling and occasional errands for the CEO. Pitch in on internal projects as needed.

**Make travel and events run smoothly**

* Book flights, hotels, and ground transportation, build itineraries, and adjust plans when travel goes sideways.
* Travel with Jacob within California to support keynotes, book signings, conferences, and partner meetings. Build relationships with hosts, clients, and event teams.
* Coordinate logistics for conferences and sponsorships, and help plan JGA’s annual company gathering and team summits.

**Handle personal logistics for the CEO (10% of the role)**

* Schedule and confirm personal appointments, make dinner reservations, and coordinate changes when plans shift.
* Handle personal insurance coordination for CEO and family.
* Order gifts, gift baskets, and track deliveries so they arrive on time.
* Handle occasional personal errands and keep private information confidential.

**What Our Values Look Like at Work**

* **Glitter** is offering a spruced-up Canva version of a slide to the CEO without being asked and sending a first-time visitor the parking instructions with a map of area restaurants before their trip to Tustin.
* **Drive** is closing the loop. If you say you’ll get back to someone, they hear from you, even if the answer is still pending.
* **Synergy** is making sure the people doing the work have the information they need, especially when a change affects three calendars.
* **Resilience** is staying steady when the flight gets canceled or the agenda changes ten minutes before the doors open.
* **Innovation** is spotting a task we do every week and finding a simpler way to get it done.
* **Humility** is pitching in wherever the team needs you. Around here, we say, “We all scrub toilets.” Yes, that includes the CEO.

**Who Thrives Here**

You’re comfortable giving a direct, tactful recommendation when two priorities collide. You enjoy building relationships, can hold your own at a high-profile event (you love meeting people), and take as much care with a calendar invite as you do with a keynote deck. You ask good questions, welcome feedback, and can turn “Can you help me with this?” into a clear next step.

* Experience in executive support and personal assistance.
* Strong written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and close attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including PowerPoint, plus Canva, LinkedIn, and a CRM.
* Based in Orange County or Long Beach and able to commute to **Tustin, CA 92782** and travel within California.
* A bachelor’s degree is preferred. Familiarity with local government is a plus.

**Physical Requirements**

* Physical Activity (Sedentary Work): Requires remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods (up to 8 hours a day).
* Manual Dexterity: Must be able to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, phone, and other office equipment. Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, filing, and data entry.
* Lifting and Moving: Occasional lifting and moving of office materials, files, and supplies up to 20 pounds (e.g., preparing packages, handling mail, storing supplies).

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist, Renewals & Growth
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**
----------------

LevelTen Energy's mission is to accelerate the energy transition by facilitating frictionless transactions. As the leading provider of renewable transaction infrastructure, we deliver the cloud-based software, centralized supply, automated analytics, and transaction expertise required to power the renewable energy economy. The LevelTen Platform is the world's largest online hub for renewable energy buyers, sellers, advisors, asset owners and financiers, and delivers the online tools and expertise they need to buy, sell and finance assets quickly.

The Account Specialist, Base Developer Renewals & Growth owns the renewal and expansion of LevelTen's Base developer clients — renewable project developers on entry-level platform packages. This role is accountable for retaining these clients, helping them get more value from the LevelTen Platform with minimal support overhead, and growing them into higher-tier packages.

This is a high-volume, scalable role. The Account Specialist will run a programmatic engagement model for the majority of accounts — onboarding, usage nudges, renewal cadences and marketing-supported campaigns — while giving higher-touch attention to the accounts with the strongest upsell potential. As a fast-growing company in a quickly evolving industry, we are always learning and improving how we support our customers, and this role will help design the playbook for how LevelTen serves and grows its Base client segment.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

**Renewals & Retention**

* Own the full renewal cycle for a large portfolio of Base developer accounts, from early renewal outreach through signed agreement
* Forecast renewals accurately in Salesforce and flag at-risk accounts early with a plan to save them
* Track platform usage and engagement signals to spot churn risk and intervene before renewal
* Hit gross and net revenue retention targets for the Base developer segment

**Growth & Upsell**

* Identify and close upsell opportunities, moving Base clients into higher-tier platform packages and add-on products
* Show developers the value of LevelTen services so they participate more actively in LevelTen marketplaces, RFPs and auctions
* Partner with Marketing on scalable campaigns (webinars, product updates, market insights) that drive adoption and expansion
* Hand off qualified larger opportunities to senior Account Managers and Transactions teams

**Scaled Engagement & Enablement**

* Onboard new Base clients on the LevelTen Platform and explain LevelTen's offline products and services
* Build self-serve resources (guides, FAQs, templates) so clients can answer routine questions without heavy support
* Triage inbound questions from Base clients and route them to the right internal team
* Support PPA and M&A transactions (RFPs and auctions), including notifying developers, providing updates, and sharing won/lost and developer report feedback

**Program Building**

* Help design and refine the Base client coverage model, renewal playbook and engagement cadence
* Define and report on segment KPIs (renewal rate, upsell revenue, platform usage) to leadership
* Work cross-functionally with Client Support, Product, Marketing and Transactions to improve the Base client experience

**Qualifications**
------------------

The ideal candidate will have:

* 3+ years of experience in account management, customer success, renewals or SaaS sales, ideally in energy software and/or energy
* Experience managing a book of ~60 accounts and meeting or exceeding renewal and upsell goals
* Comfort running scaled, programmatic engagement (email sequences, campaigns, usage-based outreach) alongside 1:1 relationships
* Clear written and verbal communication, comfortable presenting to customers, and attention to detail
* Strong organization and the ability to manage many accounts and deadlines at once
* Proficiency with Salesforce and BI/analytics tools
* Able to manage your own book of accounts, set priorities, and ask for input when needed
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with a variety of internal groups
* Ability to travel domestically [20%]

**Additional Details**
----------------------

* The estimated compensation for this position is $110,000 – $140,000 per year, (OTE $130,000 - $165,000) based on experience and qualifications.

**Benefits / Perks**
--------------------

* Full medical, vision and dental coverage
* Wellness credit
* Flexible vacation policy
* 11 paid company holidays
* 401(k) plan

**About LevelTen Energy**
-------------------------

LevelTen Energy is the leading provider of transaction infrastructure for the renewable energy economy. Our platform delivers buyers, sellers, advisors, and financiers the automation software, data management, and standardized contracts needed to facilitate faster, safer renewable energy transactions. LevelTen's marketplace of renewable energy power purchase agreements is the world's largest, with more than 4,000 Transaction-Ready Pricing™ offers spanning 21 countries in North America and Europe. LevelTen's CFO-Ready Analytics™ automatically calculate more than a billion data points every day, providing our partners with leading-edge, real-time risk and value insights at modern market scale. Together, LevelTen and our partners share #OneGoal to accelerate the clean energy transition. Visit us at LevelTenEnergy.com to learn more.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

LevelTen Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

LiveX AI is looking for a proactive, technical Customer Success Manager to own the post-sales experience for our mid-market customers. You will be the day-to-day owner of a book of existing accounts, so that our Sales and Solution Engineering teams can focus on new and strategic accounts. Sales and Solution Engineering continue to own new customer acquisition and the relationship with strategic accounts, while you support strategic accounts with day-to-day work such as version updates, configuration, and account analysis. Depending on experience, you may also manage some of our larger accounts.

This is a technical, customer-facing role. You will own anything in a customer's account that does not require a code change: configuring and updating their AI agents, resolving support issues, and keeping their deployment on the latest version of our product. For your existing accounts, you will also be the first point of contact in customer meetings, collecting information and addressing concerns before bringing in Solution Engineering when needed.

Beyond keeping accounts stable and healthy, you will review each account every week to find ways to improve results and to spot upsell opportunities, and you will keep customers up to date on new LiveX AI offerings. When an opportunity comes up, you will help close it.

Years of experience matter less to us than technical ability and initiative. This role suits someone who is technically curious, takes ownership without being asked, and enjoys working directly with customers in a fast-paced startup.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Post-Sales Technical Support**

* Get involved with new accounts after launch, and take full ownership from Sales and Solution Engineering once the deployment is stable (typically 30+ days after onboarding) and the customer is happy.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for your assigned mid-market accounts after deployment.
* Provide high-quality technical support and own the resolution of any issue that does not require a code change, such as agent configuration, knowledge base updates, conversation flows, and troubleshooting.
* Escalate issues that require engineering work to Solution Engineering with clear context and reproduction steps, and follow them through to resolution.

**Customer Meetings**

* Lead regular meetings with your existing accounts as the first-line contact, gathering requirements, feedback, and technical details.
* Address customer questions and concerns directly where you can, and hand off to Solution Engineering with a clear summary when deeper technical work is needed.

**Product Updates & Service Quality**

* Keep every customer's AI agent up to date with the latest product version so customers always receive a high-quality service.
* Plan and communicate updates with customers, test changes before release, and confirm everything works as expected afterward.

**Account Analysis & Growth**

* Review each account weekly, using conversation data and usage metrics, to identify areas for improvement and upsell opportunities.
* Share findings and recommendations with customers and with the internal team.
* Keep customers informed about the latest LiveX AI offerings and features, and explore where they could add value for each account.
* Bring upsell and expansion opportunities to the Account Executive, who decides how each one is handled, and close deals yourself when the AE hands them to you.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required**

* 1+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as Customer Success, Technical Support, Implementation, Solutions Engineering, or Account Management. Recent graduates with strong technical skills and relevant internship experience are encouraged to apply.
* Strong technical aptitude: comfortable configuring software products, troubleshooting issues, and learning new technology quickly.
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including the confidence to lead parts of customer meetings.
* Analytical skills to review account data, spot trends, and turn them into concrete recommendations.
* A proactive work style: you take ownership, follow up without being reminded, and look for problems before customers report them.

**Preferred**

* Experience selling, upselling, or closing expansion deals.
* Experience with AI, conversational AI, or B2B SaaS products.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, or basic scripting.
* Familiarity with CRM tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Experience working in an early-stage startup.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Mid-market customers receive fast, high-quality support, and most issues are resolved without involving Solution Engineering.
* Every customer's AI agent runs on the latest product version.
* Sales and Solution Engineering spend their time on new and strategic accounts rather than ongoing support for existing ones.
* Each account has a weekly review with clear improvement actions and documented upsell opportunities.
* Customer satisfaction and retention stay high, and existing accounts grow through upsells.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* **Base Salary:** $100,000 - $130,000 annually
* **Variable Compensation:** May be eligible for performance-based incentives, such as a bonus or commission, in accordance with the company's applicable plans.
* **Equity:** Stock options may be offered as part of the total compensation package.
* **Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and other company-sponsored benefits.

Compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, role responsibilities, and internal equity.

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist, Renewals & Growth
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**
----------------

LevelTen Energy's mission is to accelerate the energy transition by facilitating frictionless transactions. As the leading provider of renewable transaction infrastructure, we deliver the cloud-based software, centralized supply, automated analytics, and transaction expertise required to power the renewable energy economy. The LevelTen Platform is the world's largest online hub for renewable energy buyers, sellers, advisors, asset owners and financiers, and delivers the online tools and expertise they need to buy, sell and finance assets quickly.

The Account Specialist, Base Developer Renewals & Growth owns the renewal and expansion of LevelTen's Base developer clients — renewable project developers on entry-level platform packages. This role is accountable for retaining these clients, helping them get more value from the LevelTen Platform with minimal support overhead, and growing them into higher-tier packages.

This is a high-volume, scalable role. The Account Specialist will run a programmatic engagement model for the majority of accounts — onboarding, usage nudges, renewal cadences and marketing-supported campaigns — while giving higher-touch attention to the accounts with the strongest upsell potential. As a fast-growing company in a quickly evolving industry, we are always learning and improving how we support our customers, and this role will help design the playbook for how LevelTen serves and grows its Base client segment.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

**Renewals & Retention**

* Own the full renewal cycle for a large portfolio of Base developer accounts, from early renewal outreach through signed agreement
* Forecast renewals accurately in Salesforce and flag at-risk accounts early with a plan to save them
* Track platform usage and engagement signals to spot churn risk and intervene before renewal
* Hit gross and net revenue retention targets for the Base developer segment

**Growth & Upsell**

* Identify and close upsell opportunities, moving Base clients into higher-tier platform packages and add-on products
* Show developers the value of LevelTen services so they participate more actively in LevelTen marketplaces, RFPs and auctions
* Partner with Marketing on scalable campaigns (webinars, product updates, market insights) that drive adoption and expansion
* Hand off qualified larger opportunities to senior Account Managers and Transactions teams

**Scaled Engagement & Enablement**

* Onboard new Base clients on the LevelTen Platform and explain LevelTen's offline products and services
* Build self-serve resources (guides, FAQs, templates) so clients can answer routine questions without heavy support
* Triage inbound questions from Base clients and route them to the right internal team
* Support PPA and M&A transactions (RFPs and auctions), including notifying developers, providing updates, and sharing won/lost and developer report feedback

**Program Building**

* Help design and refine the Base client coverage model, renewal playbook and engagement cadence
* Define and report on segment KPIs (renewal rate, upsell revenue, platform usage) to leadership
* Work cross-functionally with Client Support, Product, Marketing and Transactions to improve the Base client experience

**Qualifications**
------------------

The ideal candidate will have:

* 3+ years of experience in account management, customer success, renewals or SaaS sales, ideally in energy software and/or energy
* Experience managing a book of ~60 accounts and meeting or exceeding renewal and upsell goals
* Comfort running scaled, programmatic engagement (email sequences, campaigns, usage-based outreach) alongside 1:1 relationships
* Clear written and verbal communication, comfortable presenting to customers, and attention to detail
* Strong organization and the ability to manage many accounts and deadlines at once
* Proficiency with Salesforce and BI/analytics tools
* Able to manage your own book of accounts, set priorities, and ask for input when needed
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with a variety of internal groups
* Ability to travel domestically [20%]

**Additional Details**
----------------------

* The estimated compensation for this position is $110,000 – $140,000 per year, (OTE $130,000 - $165,000) based on experience and qualifications.

**Benefits / Perks**
--------------------

* Full medical, vision and dental coverage
* Wellness credit
* Flexible vacation policy
* 11 paid company holidays
* 401(k) plan

**About LevelTen Energy**
-------------------------

LevelTen Energy is the leading provider of transaction infrastructure for the renewable energy economy. Our platform delivers buyers, sellers, advisors, and financiers the automation software, data management, and standardized contracts needed to facilitate faster, safer renewable energy transactions. LevelTen's marketplace of renewable energy power purchase agreements is the world's largest, with more than 4,000 Transaction-Ready Pricing™ offers spanning 21 countries in North America and Europe. LevelTen's CFO-Ready Analytics™ automatically calculate more than a billion data points every day, providing our partners with leading-edge, real-time risk and value insights at modern market scale. Together, LevelTen and our partners share #OneGoal to accelerate the clean energy transition. Visit us at LevelTenEnergy.com to learn more.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

LevelTen Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other legally protected status.

**Accessibility**
-----------------

I

jobs.description:
**Job Overview:**

Serendipity Home Health is seeking a motivated, outgoing, and results-driven **Healthcare Marketer / Business Development Representative** to join our growing team.

The ideal candidate will have strong communication, networking, and relationship-building skills, with a passion for healthcare outreach and business development. This individual will play an important role in expanding our company's presence, developing referral partnerships, and building relationships with healthcare professionals, hospitals, medical facilities, community organizations, and potential clients.

**Bilingual candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.** Preference will be given to qualified candidates who speak **Hindi, Urdu, or other commonly spoken Indian languages,** in addition to English, to help us better connect with diverse communities.

We are looking for someone who is proactive, professional, personable, and comfortable conducting outreach, developing new business opportunities, and representing our organization within the healthcare community.

**Jo Description:**

* Develop and execute strategic plans to identify new business opportunities within healthcare sectors, including hospitals, clinics, and pharmaceutical companies
* Conduct engaging product demonstrations to showcase technical features and benefits of medical equipment and scientific tools
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients while actively pursuing new accounts through outside sales efforts
* Negotiate deals effectively, ensuring mutually beneficial agreements that meet organizational sales targets
* Manage assigned territory by analyzing market trends, scheduling visits, and maintaining consistent contact with key decision-makers
* Utilize CRM (Customer Relationship Management) systems to track leads, sales activities, and customer interactions for optimal follow-up
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop tailored solutions that meet client needs and support product adoption
* Lead meetings, presentations, and training sessions using Microsoft PowerPoint and Word to communicate value propositions clearly

**Requirements**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.  Strong sales, marketing, and negotiation skills.  Ability to build professional relationships.  Confidence in approaching healthcare professionals and organizations.  Good presentation and public-speaking skills.  Ability to work independently and meet monthly targets.  Good organizational and time-management skills.  Basic computer skills (Microsoft Office, Excel, email, and CRM systems).  Must be comfortable with fieldwork and community outreach.

Join our team as a Healthcare Marketer / Business Development Representative if you’re passionate about advancing healthcare solutions through innovative sales strategies! This role offers the chance to grow professionally while making a tangible difference in the medical community.

Pay: $24.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

Full Time • Long Beach, CA

**Be our first sales hire.**  
Fully Promoted Long Beach is a brand-new local branch of a global brand with 300 locations in 13 countries. We're looking for a sales professional with **1+ years of B2B, outside, or territory sales experience** to build our client base from scratch across Long Beach and Signal Hill.

**What We're Looking For**

* **1+ years of B2B, outside, territory, or business development sales experience.**
* A self-motivated hunter who enjoys opening new accounts and managing their own time
* Comfortable with cold outreach, calls, and in-person visits
* Strong communication and follow-up
* Reliable transportation
* Promotional products, apparel, or printing experience is a plus, not a requirement
* No degree required. We hire for track record and drive.

**Why You'll Want This Job**

* **Be first.** No inherited accounts and no stale territory. You build the client base and grow the accounts you win.
* **Real earning potential:** base salary plus uncapped commission.
* **Get out of the office.** Most of your week is spent prospecting and meeting business owners in the field.
* **Sell what businesses reorder:** branded apparel, promotional products, signage, and marketing solutions.
* **Real training** on prospecting, objection handling, closing, products, quoting, and our systems.
* **See the whole business,** from prospecting and quoting through closing and delivery.

**What You'll Do**

* Own a defined territory across Long Beach and Signal Hill, targeting aerospace and manufacturing, port and logistics, healthcare, education, construction and trades, professional services and finance, hospitality, nonprofits, and sports organizations
* Prospect through phone, email, in-person visits, networking, and referrals
* Build relationships with owners and decision-makers
* Understand each customer's needs, then recommend the right apparel, products, signage, and marketing solutions
* Prepare quotes, follow up consistently, and close deals
* Track your pipeline in our CRM
* Turn first orders into repeat business, larger accounts, and referrals

**What Success Looks Like**

* A growing pipeline of qualified local prospects
* Consistent new meetings with decision-makers
* New accounts won and repeat orders growing
* Long-term relationships across the local business community

**About Fully Promoted Long Beach**  
Fully Promoted helps businesses grow through branded apparel, promotional products, signage, and marketing solutions. We're a new local operation backed by an established global brand, with proven systems, training, and support behind you.

**To Apply:** Send your resume and a few lines about your B2B sales experience, including how many years.

Flexible work from home options available.
